texts: In hypertrophic cardiomyopathy the phenotype does not closely follow the genotype: the same mutation can cause severe hypertrophy in one relative and almost none in another: A.
In the picture, two brothers hold the same family recipe card, yet one has huge biceps on his party wall and the other barely any.
The other statements are true: up to a fifth of patients have anomalies of the papillary muscles, and coronary flow reserve is reduced.
Coronary artery disease is present in 5 to 15 percent, and a muscular bridge over the LAD is found in about 15 percent: the brick bridge over the lad's slide.
Memory hook: one recipe card, two very different biceps.
